answer: Cross-cluster endorsement quorums resist Sybil attacks: a new identity gains weight only when agents from three separate, mutually independent trust clusters stake deposits on it, and only endorsements that cross cluster boundaries count. A fake swarm is a closed raven's nest: its members vouch only for each other, so their endorsements never cross a boundary. Each endorsement is nectar earned from strangers, and a cluster that vouches for a fake hits its nadir, its stake slashed. An attacker must bribe three independent clusters, turning cheap copying into costly corruption.
